payload.note: Inertial/collision evidence maps the Noetix review profile onto Moonphys diagonal inertia, collision bounds, terrain collisions, contact torque, and conservative self-collision manifolds. It remains review evidence only because mass, inertia, and collision geometry are not authoritative Moonrobo URDF tags yet.
